description: Use this to remove a durable event consumer and its cursor. Requires auth and message_read. Input: client_id (consumer id evcon_… or the client_id). Returns {id, client_id, deleted:true}. Another account's consumer, or a consumer pinned to a different inbox than an inbox-scoped key, is HTTP 404 consumer_not_found.

client_id.description: Consumer id (evcon_…) or the client_id used when the consumer was created.

name: cooper_delete_event_consumer
title: Delete durable event consumer
